evidence: Modifies cmake/module/AddBoostIfNeeded.cmake, depends/packages/boost.mk, vcpkg.json, and contrib/guix/libexec/build_linux.sh to eliminate Boost.Test as a build and dependency requirement.
rationale: Removes the Boost.Test dependency across depends, Guix, CMake, and vcpkg configurations. While simplifying build maintenance and environment setup, it is a non-urgent dependency reduction rather than a fix for broken builds or release-critical tooling.
